name: engineering-branch-asset-audit
title: InkForge 工程状态与分支资产梳理
description: Preservation-first audit of Git topology, dirty assets, nested repositories, worktrees, branches, and Trellis task drift before further product polishing.
creator: ZRainbow1275
notes: User decisions: maintain only main; include the full current Git-visible working snapshot; preserve HEAD's full 711-commit ancestry, including all 707 commits unique versus origin/main, via normal fast-forward; include legacy feature ancestry while keeping current code; preserve both nested unique WIP snapshots as bundle/manifest without overlaying old source. Git internals, ignored caches, browser state, and actual secrets remain excluded. The user subsequently approved every phase in implement.md, including exact-path commits, history integration, ordinary push, topology retirement, and task/filesystem convergence; preservation, secret-scan, remote-race, validation, and user-acceptance gates still apply. Two verified S0 copies now exist on a physical disk separate from source; the exposed local Grok credential found in old history was rotated and revoked before any commit. Review side effect: nested index/cache-tree metadata and reachable loose tree copies changed after an accidental write-tree; refs, staged entries, worktree content, and outer Git state did not change.
